title: The Comprehensive list of the names
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：comprehensive　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comprehensive 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the fisherman wrote of ① a comprehensive list of the names in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② more comprehensive than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the comprehensive ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most comprehensive list of the names anybody in the harbour had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1986 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too comprehensive to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the comprehensive ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a comprehensive report on the school, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as comprehensive as the report on the school they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was comprehensive or not, and he said so.

By 1999 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something comprehensive, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite comprehensive; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the comprehensive ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2002, at once, she wrote of another comprehensive list of the names in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more comprehensive than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most comprehensive report on the school in the whole harbour, she said in 2004, was the one she could never quite name; the comprehensive ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 全面（前置定语 a comprehensive list of the names：1992 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件全面的一整套名单）
B. adj. 全面／综合（比较级 more comprehensive than：文中两处，一处比一整套名单，一处比预想）
C. adj. 全面／综合（最高级 the most comprehensive：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 全面（表语 too comprehensive to do：母亲觉得它太全面，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 综合（前置定语 a comprehensive report on the school：叔叔把整件事称作一桩综合的报告）
F. adj. 综合（同级比较 as comprehensive as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学校的报告相比）
G. adj. 综合（后置定语 something comprehensive：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 综合（受程度副词修饰 quite comprehensive：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a comprehensive list of the names
the most comprehensive list of the names anybody
a comprehensive report on the school
The most comprehensive report on the school in

answers.why: comprehensive 意为“全面”，1992 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件全面的一整套名单”，此处作前置定语 a comprehensive list of the names。
comprehensive 意为“全面”，此处用比较级 more comprehensive than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
comprehensive 意为“全面”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说它是渔港里最全面的一件，故用最高级 the most comprehensive list of the names。
comprehensive 意为“全面”，母亲认为这件东西“太全面了，谁也用不上”，too comprehensive to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
comprehensive 意为“综合”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩综合的报告”，此处作前置定语 a comprehensive report on the school。
comprehensive 意为“综合”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学校的报告一样综合”，同级比较用 as comprehensive as。
comprehensive 意为“综合”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“综合的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something comprehensive。
comprehensive 意为“综合”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当综合”，quite 修饰原级 comprehensive。
comprehensive 意为“综合”，2002 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要综合”，故用比较级 more comprehensive than。
comprehensive 意为“综合”，母亲 2004 年说的是“整个渔港里最综合的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most comprehensive report on the school。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1992 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件全面的一整套名单。（a comprehensive list of the names）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更全面。（more comprehensive than …）
母亲觉得它太全面，谁也用不上。（too comprehensive to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩综合的报告。（a comprehensive report on the school）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学校的报告一样综合。（as comprehensive as …）
到了 1999 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件综合的东西。（something comprehensive）
answers: In 1992 the fisherman wrote of a comprehensive list of the names in the logbook.
Everybody said it was more comprehensive than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too comprehensive to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a comprehensive report on the school.
He said nobody would call it as comprehensive as the report on the school they had once had.
By 1999 the logbook asked for nothing but something comprehensive.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 comprehensive 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the fisherman wrote of a comprehensive list of the names in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most comprehensive list of the names in the harbour, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too comprehensive to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a comprehensive report on the school, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite comprehensive, and everybody laughed.
The comprehensive ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
